Subject: PO formatting and multi-PO invoicing for upcoming commitment

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Procurement has two constraints we need to reconcile before we can issue the first PO:

- Orchid requires a preauthorization header on every PO (PO-Auth-ID) that ties back to our ERP.
- We will need the ability to split the committed annual spend across up to 3 POs (by entity) — each PO will be invoiced monthly.
- Net terms: standard Net45, but Finance has asked whether you can accept Net30 for the first two quarters if we take Tier 2 pricing.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can:
1) include a PO-Auth-ID field in your invoice metadata,
2) accept the multi-PO approach without breaking the committed discount slab, and
3) provide an estimated first-invoice date if we issue PO# ORC-2026-9001 next week?

I attached our standard PO template. If any of this requires an amendment to the MSA, please indicate that as well.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — procurement hopes to finalize by next Wed.

Best,
Alicia Torres
Senior Procurement Manager
Orchid Health

Alicia — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and next steps: 

- PO-Auth-ID: yes, we can populate a header on invoices and include the PO-Auth-ID in the invoice metadata that flows to your ERP. That will be on the first line of the invoice and in the XML/CSV export for AP.
- Multi-PO slab integrity: we can honor the committed discount slab across multiple POs as long as the POs reference the same commitment ID (we'll map ORC-2026-9001 to DEAL-23847). Our billing system aggregates by commitment ID at settlement.
- Net terms: standard is Net45; short-term Net30 for Q3/Q4 is possible but will require a one-time billing adjustment and accounting sign-off. Vanessa and Ben are looping in to confirm impact on credit approval and to provide the redline.

If you can send the PO next week we should be able to issue the first invoice within 30 days of service activation — typically 25–35 days from the activation date depending on cutoffs.

Next steps:
1) Alicia — please confirm the exact PO numbers and which legal entities will submit each PO.
2) Vanessa — can you prepare a short pricing addendum showing the Tier 2 Net30 scenario and the accounting note for Net30 for Q3/Q4?
3) Ben — can you confirm whether we need a prepayment or credit hold for the Net30 exception?

Happy to hop on a 20-min call if that speeds things up.

—Jordan

Alicia / Jordan — attaching a redline and an accounting note. Summary below: 

- Tiered discount handling: we will namespace discounts to the commitment ID. Multiple POs referencing the same commitment ID will be credited against the same slab. This preserves the applicant discount percentage as long as aggregate spend across the POs crosses the slab thresholds within the contract period.
- Net30 exception for Q3/Q4: accounting requires either (a) a 1.5% processing fee on invoices under Net30 for the exception period, or (b) a $2500 preauthorized credit hold for the first invoice only. Option (b) releases as invoices settle.
- Invoice cadence: we will align to monthly billing per PO; our invoices contain the PO-Auth-ID and an ERPID field for mapping.

I've attached: RI_Pricing_Redline_20260830.pdf — it highlights the two paths (processing fee vs credit hold). Please review and tell us which you prefer. If you accept option (b), Ben will provision the credit hold flag so invoices move to Net30 without fee.

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

Alicia — quick operational confirmation from Billing: 

- We can accept the Orchid PO template as-is. For ERP mapping we'll need the PO-Auth-ID to be populated in the PO header (please ensure the value is consistent across POs that should be aggregated).
- To enable Net30 for Q3/Q4 under the Tier 2 pricing, we need a signed credit exception form (I can generate that and include the chosen path — fee or credit hold).
- If you pick the credit hold route (recommended for minimal ongoing fees), please indicate the dollar amount for the hold on the credit exception form — we typically see $2k–$5k for commitments at this size.
- First invoice estimate: if service activation is 09/07/2026 and we receive PO ORC-2026-9001 by 09/03/2026, first invoice will be issued the week of 10/04/2026 (billing cutoff is the 30th of each month).

I'll draft the credit exception and the intake form and share via DocuSign. Jordan — I'll need the commitment ID mapping confirmed (DEAL-23847) before I finalize.

Thanks — Ben
